credential_handling: Current Helius endpoint and key were read from the expected private source and compared in memory only. No values, hashes, prefixes, or matching content were written.

incident_and_remediation.legacy_process: A stale helius-mcp@latest npm process was observed with a credential-bearing environment assignment in argv; its npm parent and Node child were terminated.
incident_and_remediation.saved_history_check: The matching Cursor history config contained the package name and a value that did not match the current exact endpoint or key.
incident_and_remediation.active_local_configs: Codex and Cursor MCP config files point to the pinned owner-only wrapper.

limits: The earlier process-list incident and active agent transcript cannot be erased from session storage; the current tool output was redacted before it was returned.
Provider-side logs, remote conversation storage, backups, Time Machine, inaccessible files, and other sessions were not scanned.
The scan covers the listed local roots and Git objects reachable from refs; it is not a forensic disk image.
